scenarios.name: no_fault_at_commissioned_nominals
scenarios.description: Every feature sits on its commissioned nominal: evaporating 10 °C, discharge 66 °C, condensing 40 °C, liquid line 35 °C for 5 °C of subcooling. The TXV is comfortably in control.

scenarios.name: internal_bypass_leakage_full_pattern
scenarios.description: All four deviations present at once: evaporating +3 K, discharge +8 K, condensing −3.5 K, subcooling 2.5 °C (−2.5 K). The alarm lands one alarm_delay after the first tick.

scenarios.name: condenser_airflow_restriction_lookalike
scenarios.description: The source's zone-A condenser-airflow pattern: evaporating and discharge up and subcooling down exactly as for leakage, but condensing temperature UP (43 °C) instead of down. condLow blocks alone and the rule stays quiet — this is the conjunct that separates the two faults.

scenarios.name: undercharge_lookalike
scenarios.description: The source's zone-A undercharge pattern: condensing and subcooling fall while evaporating and discharge stay on nominal. Both rise conjuncts block and the rule stays quiet — HP-FC-050 owns this one.

scenarios.name: evap_rise_exactly_at_band
scenarios.description: Boundary: evaporating temperature exactly evap_sat_rise_min above nominal (12.0 °C) with the other three conjuncts satisfied. GreaterThreshold is strict, so the band edge itself reads healthy.

scenarios.name: evap_rise_just_past_band
scenarios.description: Boundary from the other side: 12.1 °C clears the strict comparison and the alarm follows on schedule.

scenarios.name: discharge_rise_exactly_at_band
scenarios.description: Boundary: discharge exactly disch_rise_min above nominal (71.0 °C) with the other three conjuncts satisfied. dschHigh blocks alone.

scenarios.name: discharge_rise_just_past_band
scenarios.description: Boundary from the other side: 71.1 °C trips dschHigh and the pattern completes.

scenarios.name: cond_fall_exactly_at_band
scenarios.description: Boundary: condensing temperature exactly cond_sat_fall_min below nominal (38.0 °C), liquid line held to keep subcooling at 2.5 °C so only condLow is at its edge.

scenarios.name: cond_fall_just_past_band
scenarios.description: Boundary from the other side: 37.9 °C condensing, liquid line moved with it to hold subcooling at 2.5 °C.

scenarios.name: subcool_fall_exactly_at_band
scenarios.description: Boundary: subcooling exactly subcool_fall_min below nominal (3.5 °C, from 36.5 − 33.0) with the other three conjuncts satisfied. scLow blocks alone.

scenarios.name: subcool_fall_just_past_band
scenarios.description: Boundary from the other side: subcooling 3.4 °C completes the pattern.

scenarios.name: txv_at_control_limit_is_no_eval
scenarios.description: Subcooling exactly at txv_control_min_subcool (0.5 °C, from 36.5 − 36.0) with every other conjunct screaming leakage. The strict comparison puts yTxvOk false, so yFault is held down and the host must read NO_EVAL rather than health.

scenarios.name: txv_just_inside_control_limit
scenarios.description: The other side of the evaluability edge: subcooling 0.6 °C clears txvOk, the pattern is judged, and the alarm asserts.

scenarios.name: transient_shorter_than_alarm_delay
scenarios.description: The full pattern appears for 1200 s — a load swing or post-defrost recovery — and then everything returns to nominal. Nothing reaches alarm_delay, so the rule never alarms.

scenarios.name: alarm_clears_after_valve_replacement
scenarios.description: Recovery: the alarm asserts, the valve is replaced at t = 2400 s and every feature returns to nominal. TrueDelay passes falling edges immediately, so yFault clears on that tick.
